name: pnpm
tagline: A package manager for JavaScript projects, with TypeScript and Rust implementations and a registry server.
hook: Distinguishes intentional v12-only features from shared bugs that must be fixed in both the Rust and TypeScript CLIs.
summary: pnpm's root guide covers three products and delegates their local rules to nested instructions. It defines version-specific development policy, warns about stale bundled tests, and explains release identifiers and platform-dependent skill discovery.

techniques.title: Separate version policy from bug parity
techniques.body: New features belong only in the Rust v12 CLI. Shared bugs require fixes in both stacks, with observable behavior aligned, so an intentional product difference is not mistaken for a defect.
techniques.quote: **Implement new features only in pnpm v12. Do not add them to pnpm v11.** A feature that intentionally exists only in v12 is not a parity gap.

techniques.title: Warn when tests exercise a stale artifact
techniques.body: The TypeScript E2E suite uses the bundled executable rather than individual package outputs. The guide requires rebuilding that bundle after package edits so the test actually covers the change.
techniques.quote: Without this step, e2e tests will use a stale bundle and your changes won't be tested.

techniques.title: Disambiguate internal and published package names
techniques.body: Rust releases target pacquet in changeset metadata, while release prose still calls the executable pnpm. The distinction prevents a Rust-only change from assigning a release to the maintained TypeScript CLI.
techniques.quote: Use `pacquet` as the changeset package name, but use `pnpm` in its release-note prose and command examples (`pnpm add`, not `pacquet add`).

techniques.title: Explain why a familiar type check fails in tests
techniques.body: The common-gotchas section shows that Error identity does not cross Jest VM realms reliably. It supplies util.types.isNativeError as the corresponding check and includes a wrong/right example.
techniques.quote: Jest runs tests in a VM context where `instanceof` checks can fail across realms.

techniques.title: Document the platform prerequisite for shared instructions
techniques.body: Claude's skill directory and root instructions use symlinks to canonical sources. The guide explains that a Windows clone without real symlink support produces text files instead, so agents fail to discover their instructions.
techniques.quote: Without it `.claude/skills` is checked out as a text file holding the target path, and Claude Code finds no skills.

steal: Distinguish intentional version differences from shared defects.
Document the artifact a test runner actually executes.
Disambiguate internal package IDs from public product names.
Show framework-specific exceptions to familiar language checks.
Record platform requirements for symlink-based instruction sharing.
outline: pnpm v12 and v11 development policy
